requestOutcomes.outcome: Official West Bengal Banglarbhumi portal did not respond within the bounded 20-second direct request; no HTML, JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, or parcel response was obtained.

First-party search/open evidence identifies the Know Your Property route and the portal's plot/mouza map services, but the returned page reports an HTTP header method change; no parcel request was made.
Official Purba Medinipur page identifies Patashpur as a district administrative block context; it is custodian/context evidence, not a parcel response.
Official Bengali district notice identifies the Purba Medinipur district land-and-land-reforms office; it does not expose parcel geometry.
Guessed English district land-records route was not found; no inference about cadastral coverage was made.
